mapper.select: SELECT TIME_FORMAT(R.RSV_START_TIME, '%H:%i') AS rsvTime, U.USER_NAME AS userName, SM.MENU_NAME AS menuName FROM RESERVATION R LEFT JOIN STORE S ON S.STORE_NO = R.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_USER SU ON SU.S_USER_ID = S.S_USER_ID LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID LEFT JOIN STORE_MENU SM ON SM.MENU_NO = R.MENU_NO WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR' AND DATE(R.RSV_DATE) = CURDATE() AND R.RSV_STATUS IN ('CNF', 'FIN') ORDER BY R.RSV_START_TIME ASC

SELECT SM.MENU_NAME AS menuName, COUNT(R.RSV_NO) AS reserveCount FROM RESERVATION R LEFT JOIN STORE S ON S.STORE_NO = R.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_USER SU ON SU.S_USER_ID = S.S_USER_ID LEFT JOIN STORE_MENU SM ON SM.MENU_NO = R.MENU_NO WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR' AND R.RSV_STATUS = 'FIN' GROUP BY SM.MENU_NO, SM.MENU_NAME ORDER BY reserveCount DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(R.RSV_DATE, '%m-%d') AS rsvDate, COUNT(R.RSV_NO) AS reserveCount FROM RESERVATION R LEFT JOIN STORE S ON S.STORE_NO = R.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_USER SU ON SU.S_USER_ID = S.S_USER_ID WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR' AND R.RSV_STATUS IN ('CNF', 'FIN') AND R.RSV_DATE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) AND CURDATE() GROUP BY R.RSV_DATE ORDER BY R.RSV_DATE ASC

SELECT S.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, S.S_CATEGORY AS sCategory, S.BIZNUM AS biznum, S.IS_OPEN AS isOpen, S.ACC_NAME AS accName, S.ACC_NO AS accNo, S.ACC_HOLDER AS accHolder, S.S_ADDR AS sAddr, S.S_FULL_ADDR AS sFullAddr, S.S_STATUS AS sStatus, S.REJ_REASON AS rejReason FROM STORE S INNER JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION R INNER JOIN STORE S ON R.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO INNER JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR' AND R.RSV_STATUS NOT IN ('FIN', 'CAN')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STORE WHERE S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND IS_OPEN = 'N'

SELECT SF.FILE_NO, SF.STORE_NO, SF.FILE_PATH, SF.FILE_NAME, SF.ORIGIN_NAME, SF.IS_MAIN FROM STORE_FILE SF INNER JOIN STORE S ON SF.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO INNER JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR' ORDER BY SF.IS_MAIN DESC, SF.FILE_NO DESC

SELECT S.STORE_NO, S.STORE_NAME, S.S_CATEGORY, S.BIZNUM, S.IS_OPEN, S.ACC_NAME, S.ACC_NO, S.ACC_HOLDER, S.S_ADDR, S.S_FULL_ADDR, SD.SUB_TITLE, SD.S_CONTENTS, SP.SLOT, SP.CAPACITY, SP.CUTOFF, SP.OPEN_TIME, SP.CLOSE_TIME, SP.BREAK_START, SP.BREAK_END, SP.OFF_DAY, SP.REFUND_POLICY, SP.SLOT FROM STORE S INNER JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID LEFT JOIN STORE_DETAIL SD ON S.STORE_NO = SD.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_POLICY SP ON S.STORE_NO = SP.STORE_NO WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR'

SELECT SM.MENU_NO, SM.STORE_NO, SM.MENU_NAME, SM.MENU_INFO, SM.MENU_PRICE, SM.REQ_TIME, SM.M_STATUS, SM.MENU_CATEGORY, CASE WHEN SM.M_STATUS = 'Y' THEN '판매중' WHEN SM.M_STATUS = 'N' THEN '판매중지' ELSE '미정' END AS M_STATUS_NAME FROM STORE S INNER JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID INNER JOIN STORE_MENU SM ON S.STORE_NO = SM.STORE_NO WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR' ORDER BY SM.MENU_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STORE_FILE ( STORE_NO, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, IS_MAIN, FILE_SIZE, FILE_EXT ) VALUES ( #{storeNo}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{originName}, #{isMain}, #{fileSize}, #{fileExt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE STORE SET IS_OPEN = #{isOpen}, ACC_NAME = #{accName}, ACC_NO = #{accNo}, ACC_HOLDER = #{accHolder}, S_ADDR = #{sAddr}, S_FULL_ADDR = #{sFullAddr} WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo}

UPDATE STORE_POLICY SET CAPACITY = #{capacity}, OPEN_TIME = #{openTime}, CLOSE_TIME = #{closeTime}, BREAK_START = #{breakStart}, BREAK_END = #{breakEnd}, SLOT = #{slot},
REFUND_POLICY = #{refundPolicy} WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo}

UPDATE STORE_MENU SET MENU_NAME = #{menuName}, MENU_CATEGORY = #{menuCategory}, MENU_INFO = #{menuInfo}, MENU_PRICE = #{menuPrice}, REQ_TIME = #{reqTime}, M_STATUS = #{mStatus} WHERE MENU_NO = #{menuNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STORE_MENU ( STORE_NO, MENU_NAME, MENU_CATEGORY, MENU_INFO, MENU_PRICE, REQ_TIME, M_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{storeNo}, #{menuName}, #{menuCategory}, #{menuInfo}, #{menuPrice}, #{reqTime}, #{mStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT S_USER_ID, S_USER_PWD, CEO_NAME AS ceoName FROM STORE_USER WHERE S_USER_ID = #{sUserId}

SELECT SUM( CASE WHEN R.RSV_DATE = CURDATE() AND R.RSV_STATUS IN ('CNF', 'FIN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS todayReservationCount, SUM( CASE WHEN R.RSV_DATE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND CURDATE() AND R.RSV_STATUS IN ('CNF', 'FIN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS weekReservationCount, SUM( CASE WHEN R.RSV_STATUS = 'FIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS completeReservationCount FROM RESERVATION R LEFT JOIN STORE S ON S.STORE_NO = R.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_USER SU ON SU.S_USER_ID = S.S_USER_ID WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR'

SELECT R.RSV_NO AS rsvNo, U.USER_NAME AS userName, U.PHONE, CONCAT(R.RSV_DATE, ' ', R.RSV_START_TIME) AS rsvDateTime, SM.MENU_NAME AS menuName, R.REQUEST AS request, P.PET_NAME AS petName, P.SPECIES AS species, P.BREED AS breed, P.BIRTHDATE AS birthdate, P.GENDER AS gender, R.RSV_STATUS AS rsvStatus, CASE WHEN R.RSV_STATUS = 'CNF' THEN '예약완료' WHEN R.RSV_STATUS = 'FIN' THEN '서비스완료' ELSE '미정' END AS rsvStatusName FROM RESERVATION R LEFT JOIN STORE S ON S.STORE_NO = R.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_USER SU ON SU.S_USER_ID = S.S_USER_ID LEFT JOIN USERS U ON R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN STORE_MENU SM ON R.MENU_NO = SM.MENU_NO LEFT JOIN PET P ON R.PET_NO = P.PET_NO WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR'
AND R.RSV_DATE = CURDATE() AND R.RSV_STATUS IN ('CNF', 'FIN')
AND R.RSV_STATUS = 'CNF'
AND R.RSV_STATUS = 'FIN'
ORDER BY R.RSV_DATE DESC, R.RSV_START_TIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(R.REVIEW_NO) AS totalReviewCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(R.RATING), 0), 1) AS avgRating, ROUND( IFNULL( AVG( CASE WHEN RE.RSV_DATE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND CURDATE() THEN R.RATING END ), 0 ), 1 ) AS recentReviewRating FROM REVIEW R LEFT JOIN STORE S ON S.STORE_NO = R.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID LEFT JOIN RESERVATION RE ON R.RSV_NO = RE.RSV_NO WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR'

SELECT SM.MENU_NO AS menuNo, SM.MENU_NAME AS menuName FROM STORE_MENU SM INNER JOIN STORE S ON SM.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO INNER JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR' AND SM.M_STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY SM.MENU_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW_REPORT ( REVIEW_NO, REPORTER_ID, REP_STATUS, REPORT_REASON ) VALUES ( #{reviewNo}, #{reporterId}, 'WAI', #{reportReason} )
mapper.update: UPDATE STORE S JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID SET S.STORE_NAME = #{storeName}, S.S_CATEGORY = #{sCategory}, S.BIZNUM = #{biznum}, S.S_ADDR = #{sAddr}, S.S_FULL_ADDR = #{sFullAddr}, S.ACC_NAME = #{accName}, S.ACC_NO = #{accNo}, S.ACC_HOLDER = #{accHolder}, S.IS_OPEN = 'Y', S.S_STATUS = 'PND', S.REJ_REASON = NULL, SU.U_STATUS = 'PND' WHERE S.STORE_NO = #{storeNo} AND S.S_STATUS = 'REJ'
